pages.text: Workers and carriers must share an owner. Keep workers and storage within the carrier’s fixed work area. Transfers need loaded terrain, a reachable route, Reach, and line of sight. Walking does not move the area’s center.

Carriers prefer eligible same-owner or mutually shared warehouses over Slime Chests. Full or unsuitable stores are skipped; partial deposits keep the remainder in cargo. If all stores are full, nothing is discarded.
A warehouse does not use itself as a transfer target, and automatic warehouse-to-warehouse cargo loops are excluded. Manually paused workers do not issue work requests.
